title: Perfect Java Lite
description: A optimized modpack for old PCs and Laptops
body:
![Perfect Java Lite Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30a4be5dbc135eb298f6aa0e88643dcc10eaf638.webp)
---
Perfect Java Lite is a modpack build for "weak" computers but it offers **Quality Of Life** featueres like [Appleskin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) and [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) and more

Perfect Java **Lite** is the "Lite" version of my modpack "[Perfect Java](https://modrinth.com/modpack/perfect-java)". It offers **more Quality of life features** but is __"heavier" for computers__, this is why I created the "Lite" version.

---
Want the full version? [Perfect Java](https://modrinth.com/modpack/perfect-java)
---

I tested on my computer (I don`t have a weak computer :)
- Windows 11
- NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060
- AMD Ryzen 5 5600G
- 16GB Of DDR4 RAM
- 1TB Gen 3 NVMe SSD

And I got **1100+ FPS**


**Test on "weak" computer comming soon**
